tool.name: Trade Ideas
tool.description: Trade Ideas is a US stock scanner with real-time alerts, charts and paper trading. The Premium plan adds backtesting and auto-trading tools on top of the Standard scanner.
features: Real-time stock data, custom scans and screeners
Up to 10 charts, layouts and in-app paper trading on Standard
Premium adds backtesting, auto trading and extra strategy windows
Annual billing is listed, and monthly billing is offered

plans.name: Standard
plans.detail: The page calls this equivalent to $89 per month and a $456 a year saving versus monthly.

plans.name: Premium
plans.detail: The page calls this equivalent to $178 per month and a $912 a year saving versus monthly.

tool.pricing_note: Annual prices from the official pricing page on 11 Oct 2026. Monthly billing is offered, but the monthly dollar amount was not in the page text we captured.
